dicom_input_prefix.description: S3 prefix containing DICOM files. HealthOmics localizes the entire prefix into a directory before the task runs.

deidentification_profile.description: S3 path to the JSON de-identification profile (see profiles/ps315_basic_tcia_v1.json).

container.description: ECR container image URI built by build_and_push_container.sh.

emit_jpeg_previews.description: Emit before/after JPEG previews per instance for visual verification (default false).
